title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-95-24一模

items.zh: 如果不好好准备，周五的演讲可能会变得一塌糊涂。
items.en: The speech on Friday might go south without adequate preparation.

items.zh: 市民们呼吁废纸回收再利用,以减少对原材料的消耗。
items.en: Citizens call for the recycling of waste paper to reduce the consumption of raw materials.

items.zh: 电影里出现了许多主人公穿越沙漠的场景，象征着一种自我发现和成长的过程。
items.en: There are many scenes in the film where the leading character crosses the desert, symbolizing a process of self-discovery and growth.

items.zh: 艺术博物馆位于中国著名的文化城市杭州，在那里游客们可以欣赏风格多样的艺术作品，仿佛置身于艺术的海洋之中。
items.en: Located in Hangzhou, a renowned cultural city in China, the art museum is a place where tourists can appreciate diverse styles of works as if immersed in an ocean of art.
